notes.title: Version 1.02 update
notes.content:
Just a little update with some bug fixes and improvements.


 Changed [spoiler]'flower' to 'petal'[/spoiler] in some item descriptions to be more accurate.
 One item referred to [spoiler]'mind'[/spoiler] when it should have said [spoiler]'spirit'[/spoiler]
 Fixed text when looking at [spoiler]the cannon[/spoiler]. It could sometimes tell you that you had more of the task completed than you had.
 There was an audio and visual bug if you completed the game more than once without the game closing in between.
 The animation scene when travelling around [spoiler]the locations in the past[/spoiler] is now shorter if you are going the same route a second time.
 Fixed music bug in final area where music was not changing when [spoiler]creatures appear[/spoiler].
 Added a background item to the [spoiler]Yith ruins that is also present in the city in the past to reference the size difference between Yith and human[/spoiler].
 Made the collision on the backdoor into the [spoiler]log room[/spoiler] larger as it was somewhat obscured by the metal gate door.
